title: Barbaad hua haaye Mohd ka gharana
body:
BARBAAD HUWA HAYE MOHAMMED KA GHARANA
Zakhmi huwa Humshakl-e-Payambar ka kaleja
Seene mein tha atthara(18) baras wale ke naiza
Jab mar gaya Laila ka pisar mannato wala
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabbir ne rote huwe bachcho ko pukara
Maidan ko phir Aun-o-Mohammed bhi sidhare
Sarwar pa fida hogaye Zainab ke dulare
Qaimo mein junhi aagaye do betaun ke laashe
<<DIVIDER>>
Lasho’n ke qaree’n Zainab-e-Muztar ka wo sajda
Shadi huwe kuch der ki dulhan bani kubra
Phir Qasim-e-Naushah bhi maqtal ko sidhara
Shabbir ne kis dil se khuda jaane hai dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
Maidan me bikhra huwa Shabbar ka kaleja
Abbas ke shaane kate tha Zakhmi sarapa
Mashkiza chhida sar pa laga gurz-e-sitam ka
Ghode se gira kaise khuda jane wo pyasa
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabbir kamar thame huwe padhte the nauha
Chhe (6) maah ke Asgher ke gale par jo laga teer
Us nanhe se laashe ko liye rote the Shabbir
Bechain dar-e-qaima pe the Bano-e-dilgeer
<<DIVIDER>>
Shai sonchte the ghamzada maadar se kahe kya
Jab Fatema ka laal huwa dasht mein tanha
Mazloom pa hone laga har simt se hamla
Talwaar kabhi teer to pathar kabhi naiza
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghode pa laga jhoomne Ahmed ka nawasa
Zakhmi huwa ghode se gira Dilbar-e-Hyder
Chillati rahi peet ke sar Zainab-e-Muztar
Aur Sibt-e-Payambar ke gale par chala khanjar
<<DIVIDER>>
Faryaad kuna dasht mein thi Fatima Zehra
Aye Saqi-e-Kausar ke pisar dilbar-e-Zehra
Marooza Rasheed apse karta hai ye aqa
Hum sab ko dikha dijiye jald apka roza
<<DIVIDER>>
Karlije qubool ap ye na cheez ka nauha
